inputs.original_text: PARIS, France— In a case that has sent ripples of concern through religious communities and civil liberties advocates across France, a French abbot has been convicted under a controversial new law targeting “psychological subjection.” The conviction of Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), under France’s new law has ignited a [...]
inputs.modified_text: Look at what the secular, progressive establishment is doing in France now. They are completely undermining traditional faith, family, and religious authority by targeting Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), under a disgraceful new law targeting “psychological subjection.” This is a direct assault on spiritual leadership and the traditional communities that preserve our moral fabric, sending ripples of concern through religious communities and civil liberties advocates across France. When the state starts criminalizing traditional religious hierarchy and spiritual guidance under vague, modern pretexts, they aren't protecting anyone—they are tearing down the foundations of our civilization. It’s an outrage against natural order and religious freedom.
